title: Stabilize calendar bootstrapping and React Query refresh across auth/actor/profile/unlock transitions

requirements.summary: Gate Events/Tasks rendering behind auth + actor readiness + user profile readiness + encryption unlock, and show a consistent, non-destructive authenticated loading state while prerequisites resolve (English text only).
acceptanceCriteria: After login (and after re-login), the app displays a consistent loading state while the actor/profile/unlock requirements are still resolving.
EventsView and TasksView are not rendered in a way that can produce a transient destructive error alert during normal startup (e.g., while actor/key/principal are still becoming available).
All user-facing loading/error text introduced or modified is in English.

file_operations.description: Add an authenticated-only loading screen component that explains the app is preparing the secure calendar (English text), without showing destructive alerts; include minimal layout consistent with existing app styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Refine the authenticated boot flow so that when identity is present but actor/profile prerequisites are still resolving, the app renders AuthenticatedLoadingScreen instead of rendering nothing (and still renders ProfileSetupModal / PassphraseUnlockModal / Shell only when their prerequisites are satisfied). Ensure Events/Tasks views cannot mount before actor + profile + unlock are ready. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden the view against prerequisite-transition states by avoiding destructive error UI for known non-fatal startup conditions (e.g., actor/key temporarily unavailable) and showing a neutral loading/pending state instead; keep genuine fetch/decrypt failures actionable via Retry. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Mirror EventsView behavior: suppress destructive error UI for known non-fatal startup conditions during normal startup transitions and show a neutral loading/pending state instead; keep genuine fetch/decrypt failures actionable via Retry. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make events/tasks React Query refetch reliably after logout/login (even same principal) and subsequent unlock by tying query enablement and cache keys/invalidation to actor readiness and encryption unlock state, without touching immutablePaths.
acceptanceCriteria: Repro path: login → unlock → create at least one event/task → logout → login again → unlock → events/tasks load automatically and display the saved items.
No persistent “Failed to load events” / “Failed to load tasks” error appears in the above flow unless there is an actual backend/decryption failure.
If a real fetch/decrypt error occurs, the error state remains actionable (e.g., Retry still works) and does not get stuck due to stale query state from a prior session.

file_operations.description: Extend the encryption session store to expose a monotonically increasing unlock/session version (or similar) that changes on successful unlock and resets on lock/logout, so other code can reliably detect a new decryption context.

Refine events/tasks query keys and enablement to incorporate (a) authenticated principal, (b) actor readiness, and (c) the encryption session's unlock/session version so that after re-login and unlock, queries automatically run against the fresh decryption context and do not remain stuck in prior-session error states; keep retry/refetch behavior actionable and avoid running queries before prerequisites are satisfied.

Align mutation invalidation/refetch strategy with the refined query keys (including the unlock/session version where appropriate) so post-mutation lists stay consistent after relogin/unlock cycles, without requiring a manual refresh or user pressing Retry.
